name: MERUNA / No-show & Recovery / Central Orchestrator v1

nodes.name: 01 Detect and Confirm Real No Shows

parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT appointment_id
  FROM public.find_no_show_candidates(100)
), confirmed AS (
  SELECT c.appointment_id, public.core_confirm_no_show(
    c.appointment_id,
    'n8n:no-show-orchestrator:' || c.appointment_id::text,
    'no-show-orchestrator:confirm:' || c.appointment_id::text
  ) AS result
  FROM candidates c
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates)::integer AS candidates_found,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS confirmed_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'code' = 'ALREADY_CONFIRMED')::integer AS already_confirmed_count
FROM confirmed;

WITH events AS (
  SELECT de.entity_id, de.id, de.clinic_id, de.correlation_id
  FROM public.domain_events de
  JOIN public.appointments a
    ON a.id = de.entity_id
   AND a.clinic_id = de.clinic_id
   AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND a.appointment_status = 'no_show'
  WHERE de.event_type = 'appointment.no_show_confirmed'
    AND de.entity_type = 'appointment'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.no_show_cases c
      WHERE c.appointment_id = de.entity_id
        AND c.clinic_id = de.clinic_id
    )
  ORDER BY de.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 100
), created AS (
  SELECT e.entity_id, public.create_recovery_case(
    e.entity_id,
    e.id,
    COALESCE(e.correlation_id, 'n8n:no-show-orchestrator:case:' || e.entity_id::text),
    'no-show-orchestrator:case:' || e.entity_id::text
  ) AS result
  FROM events e
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events)::integer AS eligible_events,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS cases_created_or_replayed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'code' = 'CASE_ALREADY_EXISTS')::integer AS cases_replayed
FROM created;

WITH open_cases AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.no_show_cases
  WHERE case_status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'ELIGIBLE')
  ORDER BY updated_at ASC
  LIMIT 100
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.id, public.classify_no_show(o.id) AS classification_result
  FROM open_cases o
), evaluated AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.classification_result, public.evaluate_no_show_policy(c.id) AS policy_result
  FROM classified c
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM open_cases)::integer AS open_cases_found,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE classification_result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS classified_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE policy_result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS policy_evaluated_count
FROM evaluated;

nodes.name: 04 Claim Recovery and Follow Up Attempts

parameters.query:
WITH outreach AS (
  SELECT public.claim_no_show_recovery_attempt(
    c.id, 'OUTREACH', NULL,
    'n8n:no-show-orchestrator:outreach:' || c.id::text,
    'no-show-orchestrator:outreach:' || c.id::text || ':' || (c.current_attempt_number + 1)::text
  ) AS result
  FROM public.no_show_cases c
  JOIN public.no_show_runtime_config r ON r.clinic_id = c.clinic_id
  WHERE r.outreach_mode = 'LIVE'
    AND c.created_at >= r.launch_watermark
    AND c.case_status = 'ELIGIBLE'
    AND c.recovery_eligibility = 'ELIGIBLE'
    AND (c.recovery_deadline IS NULL OR c.recovery_deadline > now())
    AND c.current_attempt_number < c.max_attempts
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.no_show_recovery_attempts a WHERE a.case_id = c.id AND a.status IN ('PENDING','REQUESTED','IN_PROGRESS'))
  ORDER BY c.last_activity_at ASC
  LIMIT 100
), followups AS (
  SELECT public.claim_no_show_recovery_attempt(
    c.id, 'FOLLOW_UP', NULL,
    'n8n:no-show-orchestrator:followup:' || c.id::text,
    'no-show-orchestrator:followup:' || c.id::text || ':' || (c.current_attempt_number + 1)::text
  ) AS result
  FROM public.no_show_cases c
  JOIN public.no_show_runtime_config r ON r.clinic_id = c.clinic_id
  WHERE r.outreach_mode = 'LIVE'
    AND c.created_at >= r.launch_watermark
    AND c.case_status = 'RECOVERY_ACTIVE'
    AND c.recovery_eligibility = 'ELIGIBLE'
    AND (c.recovery_deadline IS NULL OR c.recovery_deadline > now())
    AND c.current_attempt_number < c.max_attempts
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.no_show_recovery_attempts a WHERE a.case_id = c.id AND a.status = 'NO_RESPONSE')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.no_show_recovery_attempts a WHERE a.case_id = c.id AND a.status IN ('PENDING','REQUESTED','IN_PROGRESS'))
  ORDER BY c.last_activity_at ASC
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach)::integer AS outreach_candidates,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followups)::integer AS followup_candidates,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS outreach_claimed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followups WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS followups_claimed;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT a.id AS attempt_id, a.channel_category, a.conversation_id, a.correlation_id
  FROM public.no_show_recovery_attempts a
  JOIN public.no_show_cases c ON c.id = a.case_id AND c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
  JOIN public.no_show_runtime_config r ON r.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
  WHERE r.outreach_mode = 'LIVE'
    AND a.status IN ('REQUESTED','IN_PROGRESS')
    AND a.notification_domain_event_id IS NULL
    AND a.requested_at >= r.launch_watermark
    AND c.recovery_eligibility = 'ELIGIBLE'
    AND c.case_status IN ('RECOVERY_ACTIVE','HANDOFF_ACTIVE')
  ORDER BY a.requested_at ASC, a.id ASC
  LIMIT 50
), requested AS (
  SELECT public.request_no_show_recovery_notification(
    c.attempt_id, c.channel_category, c.conversation_id, c.correlation_id
  ) AS result
  FROM candidates c
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates)::integer AS notification_candidates,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS notifications_requested,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'code' = 'OUTREACH_DISABLED')::integer AS outreach_disabled_count
FROM requested;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS attempt_id,
    CASE
      WHEN j.status = 'DEAD_LETTER' THEN 'FAILED'
      WHEN j.status = 'SENT'
       AND now() >= COALESCE(a.started_at, a.requested_at, a.created_at)
         + make_interval(mins => GREATEST(
             CASE WHEN c.policy_snapshot->>'attempt_spacing_minutes' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
               THEN (c.policy_snapshot->>'attempt_spacing_minutes')::integer
               ELSE 1440 END,
             1))
      THEN 'NO_RESPONSE'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS target_status,
    CASE WHEN j.status = 'DEAD_LETTER' THEN 'DELIVERY_FAILED' ELSE 'NO_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT' END AS response_type,
    CASE WHEN j.status = 'DEAD_LETTER' THEN COALESCE(j.last_error_category, 'NOTIFICATION_DEAD_LETTER') ELSE NULL END AS failure_code
  FROM public.no_show_recovery_attempts a
  JOIN public.no_show_cases c ON c.id = a.case_id AND c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
  JOIN public.notification_jobs j ON j.id = a.notification_job_id AND j.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
  WHERE a.status IN ('REQUESTED','IN_PROGRESS')
    AND j.status IN ('SENT','DEAD_LETTER')
), completed AS (
  SELECT public.complete_no_show_recovery_attempt(
    c.attempt_id, c.target_status, c.response_type, c.failure_code
  ) AS result
  FROM candidates c
  WHERE c.target_status IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates WHERE target_status IS NOT NULL)::integer AS outcome_candidates,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS outcomes_completed
FROM completed;

WITH stale_cases AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.no_show_cases
  WHERE case_status IN ('CONFIRMED','ELIGIBLE','RECOVERY_ACTIVE','HANDOFF_ACTIVE')
    AND (updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes' OR recovery_deadline < now())
  ORDER BY updated_at ASC
  LIMIT 100
), reconciled AS (
  SELECT public.reconcile_no_show_case(s.id) AS result
  FROM stale_cases s
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stale_cases)::integer AS stale_cases_found,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result->>'success' = 'true')::integer AS reconciled_count
FROM reconciled;
